row.notes: thunk -> .data1 0x15537d4f0; cb = {bool fn(ctx, threshold), ctx}; model = Game_Get_ModelNodeId(name); params 0x70 bytes (int type 2, float 0.4, 4x4 identity at +0x10, extents 0.05 at +0x50); also registers '<name>_%03d' sub-pieces; part object (0x200 bytes, vtable 0x145bf94d0) in the car part manager car+0x2c8, appended to fw+0xb0; part+0x18/+0x20 fn/ctx, +0x30 threshold, +0x38 detached, +0x130 hit count (>= 100 detaches); part update slot 3 0x1446686d0 calls fn(ctx, threshold) every frame, true -> detach (slot 0xa0). Fails (no part) if the model has no such node (0x143cfc8f0 = -1). (used by the vmknolle addons parts-detach) | PR #453/#448 (vmknolle): jmp stub into .data1 (0x15537d4f0). Register a detachable car part: args (component, callback {fn, ctx} 16 bytes, &node name id, 0x70-byte part descriptor (matrix + extents), float factor). Builds the part record on the stack, resolves the model node (0x1446612a0 with the name id; logs the node name from the name table 0x14618ce18 on a miss, format 0x145bf4637) (car-re fix: 0x1446612a0 is Car_Add_DetachablePart_Thunk, which creates the part and appends it; nothing is logged on a miss, the body just returns; 0x14618ce18 is the name table lock and 0x145bf4637 is '%s_%03d', used after a success to name the sub-pieces) and appends the part to component+0xb0..+0xb8 via the component's allocator ([+0xb8-8] vcall +0x88) (car-re fix: the append is inside 0x1446612a0, allocator fw+0xa8; [fw+0xb8-8] is the part just added and its vtable +0x88 returns its node transform part+0x60, used for the sub-piece distance). 11 calls from the front wing init (0x14465f898 ..). (used by vmknolle parts-detach) | car-re 2026-10-28 L2 (kb:subsystems/car.md#parts): body read on the Steam build. At 0x15537d5e9 calls Car_Add_DetachablePart_Thunk(fw, cb, &id, params, k) = Car_Create_DetachablePart([fw+8]+0x2c8, ...) then append to fw+0xb0..+0xb8 (cap +0xc0); returns at once when that fails. Then registers sub-pieces '<name>_001', '_002', ... (0x15537d73b, same cb and params) until one fails; each sub-piece's +0x30 = 1 - d when k == 1.0, else min(0.99, k + d), d = min(0.2, 2 x the distance between its and the main piece's node translations (part+0x90)), and its +0x1f4 = 1. The main piece keeps k unchanged at +0x30 (V1191's transform is for the sub-pieces only). k is the predicate multiplier: the part update calls fn(ctx, part+0x30). 11 callers, all in Car_FrontWing_Init, the 11th at 0x14465fd58 (V1191); no other .xtls caller. Prior evidence V1191 (verify-f, agree at L1).
